verdict.rationale: BILL's own S&E marketing says its cards ensure 'every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant.' The developer docs also mention setting up budgets and virtual cards. That is only a thin, generic claim of card spend controls, with no documented category, merchant, or amount restrictions and no point-of-sale decline behavior. Missing for 10: documented merchant/MCC category restrictions, per-card amount limits, auto-lock or decline of out-of-policy spend at the point of sale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
